newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shipyard venture plans S$32 mln dormitory.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shipyard venture plans S$32 mln dormitory.

text.p: Hitachi Zosen Singapore Ltd (HZSL) on Thursday said it had formed a joint venture with three other shipyards to build, own and manage a Singapore $32 million dormitory to house their foreign workers.

The joint venture, Joint Shipyard Management Services Pte Ltd, involves three other parties -- Jurong Shipyard Ltd (JSL), Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp subsidiary Singapore Technologies Shipbuilding & Engineering Ltd (STSE) and Pan-United Shipyard Pte Ltd (PUY), HZSL said in a statement.
JSL has 33 percent of the joint venture, STSE 30 percent, HZSL 23 percent and PUY 14 percent.
Construction started last month, HZSL said.
